data.content_ref: inline:This conjecture abstracts the diagnostic overlay programme: every admissible derived diagnostic — suspend_reason (SRC_003), RESIDUE (SRC_009), standing residue (SRC_005), and DefenseWitness (SRC_002) — is a polynomial-time total function of the unique final grounded labeling and the admitted graph, never an input to the fixpoint, so the covering principle is that derived diagnostics are exactly the class of deterministic post-fixpoint annotations and each instance inherits determinism and polynomial cost. REFUTED IF there exists a diagnostic in the neighbourhood whose computation requires reading a pre-fixpoint label, a non-final labeling, or an edge absent from the admitted graph — i.e., if any diagnostic is not a pure function of the final (labels, edges) pair, the abstraction fails.
